messages:
olivia: FYI ran the k8s + simulator sweep for dedicated capacity SLOs. Uploading quick notes.

maria: thanks — can you paste the main results?

olivia: P95 token latency under steady-state at commit capacity: 110ms. P99: 280ms. Tail spikes when queue > 500 reqs.

aj: can you share the load curve? we need the warmup ramp vs coldpath impact.

olivia: attached plot in gist: https://gist.github.com/olivia/dummy (placeholder)

samir: from sims, autoscaler convergence time is ~75s for 2->8 GPU step on our test cluster. That exceeds target of 60s.

devin: is that linear scaling? what's throughput per GPU at 512 seq? we need tokens/sec.

olivia: throughput/gpu @512 seq ~= 2200 tokens/s. Batching knob at runtime reduces latency but increases throughput. Ran two configs:
```
# config A
batch_max_tokens: 2048
max_batch_delay_ms: 10
# config B
batch_max_tokens: 4096
max_batch_delay_ms: 5
```
Config A had better p99 stability.

maria: acceptance criteria proposal:
- P95 <= 150ms at commit capacity
- P99 <= 300ms at commit capacity
- Autoscale to target within 60s for 2x traffic spike
- Graceful degrade: fallback to smaller model variant within 2s when queue growth > 3x baseline
- No more than 2% error increase vs baseline

aj: :thumbsup: on criteria. edgecase: what about mixed request sizes? small chat messages vs long generation?

olivia: tested mixed workload 70/30 short/long — p99 increased by ~12% but still within 300ms in majority of runs.

samir: follow-ups:
1) tune autoscaler step size and add predictive warmup (based on traffic forecasting)
2) add KV cache warming for common prefixes
3) run region-failover sim

ops-bot: deploy plan created: deployment/ci/1719998888-sim => staging. Trigger with `/deploy sim` when ready :rocket:

devin: can we get a final sign-off to include in PRD? i'll collate into the acceptance checklist.

maria: sign-off pending small item: we need rollback criteria (latency > 400ms for >5m) and a canary window of 15m

olivia: added rollback + canary window to doc. I'll drop full sim logs into the PR.

aj: thanks everyone. next step: draft PRD section and hand to eng for implementation plan.

maria: assigning owners: aj (autoscale), samir (runtime tuning), olivia (sim + docs), devin (throughput validation)

olivia: cool, i'll open a PR with the sims and acceptance checklist by EOD. :white_check_mark:
